mapper.select:
SELECT policy_id AS policyId, policy_type AS policyType, title, content, is_required AS isRequired, is_active AS isActive, updated_at AS updatedAt, created_at AS createdAt
FROM POLICY
ORDER BY policy_id ASC

SELECT hours_id AS hoursId, day_of_week AS dayOfWeek, start_time AS startTime, end_time AS endTime, is_closed AS isClosed FROM CUSTOMER_SERVICE_HOURS ORDER BY FIELD( day_of_week, 'MON', 'TUE', 'WED', 'THU', 'FRI', 'SAT', 'SUN' )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CUSTOMER_SERVICE_HOURS ( day_of_week, start_time, end_time, is_closed ) VALUES ( #{dayOfWeek}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{isClosed} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE start_time = VALUES(start_time), end_time = VALUES(end_time), is_closed = VALUES(is_closed)
